fields.label: Raw cloud path (if no artifact picked)
fields.help: Full path to a raw cloud (.txt/.csv/.las/.laz). Use this OR pick a pointcloud artifact above - exactly one of the two.

fields.label: Run up to stage
fields.help: Run up to and including this stage (CLI --to; default: the last stage).

fields.label: Run tag
fields.help: Suffix for geohazard's native run folder name (CLI --tag). Empty = none.

fields.label: Batch mode (--yes)
fields.help: Accept proposed defaults (non-interactive where safe). Still HARD-STOPS if north cannot be verified.

fields.label: Random seed
fields.help: PipelineConfig.random_seed.

fields.label: Facets: normal radius (x s)
fields.help: Normal estimation neighborhood radius, in multiples of spacing s.

fields.label: Facets: region-growing angle (deg)
fields.help: Max angle between neighbor normals.

fields.label: Facets: kNN graph size
fields.help: Neighbor graph size for region growing.

fields.label: Facets: min facet points
fields.help: Discard smaller facets.

fields.label: Facets: joint-set max k
fields.help: BIC search upper bound for joint-set clustering.

fields.label: Facets: fixed joint-set count
fields.help: Force an exact number of joint sets (skips BIC). Empty = let BIC choose. Use when the set count is known from field mapping.

fields.label: Facets: use input normals
fields.help: Use normals supplied in the input file (roles Nx, Ny, Nz) instead of computing them.

fields.label: Facets: flip normals
fields.help: Force-invert all normals after automatic orientation. Sign is CRITICAL for convex/concave classification in S5.

fields.label: Edges: adjacency tolerance (x s)
fields.help: tau, multiples of s.

fields.label: Edges: min inter-normal angle (deg)
fields.help: Reject near-parallel facet pairs.

fields.label: Edges: min edge length (x s)
fields.help: Shorter contacts are degenerate.

fields.label: Sectors: mode
fields.help: auto: breaks where face orientation drifts; manual: breaks from config; off: single sector (v16 behaviour).

fields.label: Sectors: max drift (deg)
fields.help: New sector when the face drifts this far.

fields.label: Stereonet: display friction (deg)
fields.help: Friction angle for the envelope DRAWN on the stereonet (S6 still sweeps the full range).

fields.label: Stereonet: min chain length (m)
fields.help: 0 = keep all chains.

fields.label: Stereonet: exclude sets
fields.help: Joint sets to keep out of the kinematic tests (e.g. the excavated face), space-separated integers. Empty = ask at run time; -1 = exclude nothing.

fields.label: Stereonet: length-weighted
fields.help: Weight each lineation by chain length (recommended).

fields.label: Stereonet: figure DPI
fields.help: Figure output resolution.

fields.label: Hazard: grid cell (m)
fields.help: Grid cell size in metres (physical - hazard concerns real block scales).

fields.label: Hazard: friction sweep (deg)
fields.help: Wedge layers are computed at every angle, space-separated.

fields.label: Hazard: toppling phi (deg)
fields.help: Toppling friction angle.

fields.label: Point density: enabled
fields.help: Per-point (moving-neighbourhood) hazard fields.

fields.label: Point density: radius (m)
fields.help: Empty = radius_mult_spacing x measured spacing, proposed to the operator for confirmation.
